description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Makandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420500
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and owner identities. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
